title: Share-Backed Finance
summary: Lending secured against listed or unlisted shareholdings, sized to the value and liquidity of the pledged shares.

segments.name: Jewelry Retail
examples: A Thai SET-listed company engaged in gold jewelry retail and gold-backed lending (pawn services) seeking short-term liquidity need of 500m THB

segments.name: Export Houses
examples: Thai listed fruit exporter with working capital need of 200m THB
